description: Defines wizard interfaces for opening, confirming, and validating timesheets by department manager in Odoo, including methods to fetch related user and department data.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_open
classes.description: Wizard for opening timesheets related to departments managed by the user.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_confirm_open
classes.description: Wizard for opening draft timesheets related to departments managed by the user.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_validate_open
classes.description: Wizard for opening confirmed timesheets related to departments managed by the user.

methods.name: _open_timesheet
methods.description: Fetches department members managed by the user and returns an action to open related timesheets with specific domain filters.
